title: A longer steady current
hook: Change duration and predict charge transferred.
misconception: charge transferred stays fixed when duration doubles.
objective: Apply Q = It to compare charge transferred when duration changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a steady one-direction current with fixed magnitude, Q = It. When duration doubles, charge transferred becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Q = It; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a steady one-direction current with fixed magnitude, with a nonzero initial result. If duration triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on charge transferred?
recall.why: Apply Q = It under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
